content: react-day-picker v10 (daypicker.dev) supports custom Day/DayButton components via the components prop, replacing the deprecated v8 useDayRender hook. Day controls the table cell wrapper, DayButton controls the interactive button inside it. This lets you inject custom content into a day cell, but DayButton still renders a native <button> element -- putting multiple independently-meaningful chips (each representing a different agenda item) inside a single button is awkward both semantically and for click-through to a specific item. The library's month grid is a <table role="grid"> built for single-date-selection semantics (radiogroup-like), not a multi-event calendar; it also has no week or day list view mode at all, so month, week, and day would need two different rendering systems if react-day-picker were adopted for month only.
